nativeIdentity: session.id:value, derived string reference; no inode/content identity
nativeMessageId: SessionDB SQLite id is returned by hermes_cli.web_server /api/sessions/{id}/messages, though omitted from Renderer SessionMessage typing; Host projection preserves it
taskIdInTools: Internal tool execution context is not a durable Artifact Task entity
nativeEvents: No artifact.* lifecycle; message.start/delta/complete and tool events are turn/tool events
nativePersistence: Artifact rows are re-derived; state.db persists message/tool result provenance; workspace stores current bytes
deleteRestore: No artifact-specific native delete/restore protocol; not exposed by Host
nativePreviewDownload: Native image/media/Desktop FS bridges; Host uses existing authenticated FS and Electron download
permissions: Existing Main/Preload FS hardening and authenticated remote bridge; no new IPC or widened permissions
parserRisks: Tool input paths and arbitrary assistant links are native reference candidates, not completed outputs. Host removes tool arguments/external URLs and requires successful files_modified evidence for confirmed writes.
